policy.coverageRule: Every legal factor-value pair MUST be present in at least one generated per-process scenario.
policy.antiGamingRule: A pair may be excluded only when the process contract makes the two abstract factor states semantically impossible to coexist; inconvenience, expected FAIL/BLOCKED outcome, missing evidence, unsupported model, boundary violation or implementation difficulty are not exclusion reasons.

reasonCodes.meaning: The two factor values cannot coexist in one valid semantic scenario for the named process under the active process contract.
One factor value has no semantic meaning for the named process and cannot be represented even as a negative/unsupported qualification state.

currentClosure.rationale: The eight factor levels are qualification intents rather than literal product states. Negative, unsupported, zero-cardinality, cross-discipline and mutation states are deliberately representable together, so the strongest current closure treats every pair as legal instead of gaming coverage by excluding difficult pairs.
